summary: DEFSEC Technologies, a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a 6-K with a news release announcing a 9-to-1 share consolidation (reverse split) effective 12:01 a.m. EDT November 16, 2026, approved by the board November 4. Shares outstanding fall from 4,593,998 to roughly 510,444, with fractional shares rounded down and cancelled; CUSIP 244778205 and ISIN CA2447782053. The move targets Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance and awaits final TSXV and Nasdaq approval. Options and warrants adjust proportionately; Listed Warrants trade unchanged. This is a capital-structure maintenance step, not a special situation; watch for post-split bid-price compliance and warrant overhang.
